committee.sub: Morning brief · Sunday 20 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend climbed from $115.57 to $173.41 last7 and clicks from 19 to 27, yet conversions stayed at zero. Post restart clicks sit at 44 of the 150 stop loss threshold, still with zero leads.

Budget lost 30d is 20.7% against rank lost 30d at 73.7%, so the budget conversation has not opened. Impression share is only 10%, and CTR fell from 5.5% to 3.1% even as impressions nearly tripled from 347 to 885.

The homepage (35 sessions) and /ai-automation-agency.html (22 sessions) carried almost all of last7's traffic, but calculator usedLast7 is 0 despite 59 sessions, meaning the ungated calculator step is not being engaged.

AI Assistant sessions moved from 0 to 2 last7 with chatgpt.com as the top source, worth watching given this likely undercounts as Direct jumped from 11 to 24. Organic remains thin too: the top page /simpro-xero-integration.html drew 105 impressions but 0 clicks at position 20, and Search Console only reports through 16 Sept, three days behind yesterday's data.

actions.text: Get the logo and image assets finalised and add keyword matched RSA headlines for the ad groups still serving.
Fix the homepage form so kontrolTrackLead fires only after the Formspree confirm, not before it.
Update RSA description D1, it still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week and needs to match the current site stats.
